item.title: As Rockets Fly Overhead, Residents of Israel’s Border City Stay Underground
item.summary: The Israeli government evacuated Kiryat Shmona during the last round of fighting with Hezbollah in 2023. Residents who were told it was safe to return are again under fire.

item.title: Amid War in Iran, Europe’s Flashes of Military Strength Also Show Its Weakness
item.summary: To defend allies from Iran, the continent’s powers have mounted a rare show of force. But those efforts have diverted limited resources from other hot spots.

item.title: Netanyahu Has the War He Always Wanted, but on Trump’s Terms

item.title: Israel Says Michigan Synagogue Attacker’s Brother Was a Hezbollah Commander
